description: This Java class defines a custom Android DocumentsProvider named VaultProvider that manages encrypted storage of documents and directories, with support for creating, renaming, deleting, querying, and reading/writing document contents. It handles encryption keys, metadata management, and document hierarchy within an encrypted vault system.

classes.name: VaultProvider
classes.description: A custom Android DocumentsProvider that encrypts metadata and content of documents, manages document hierarchy, and provides CRUD operations within an encrypted vault system.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loads or generates cryptographic keys, and sets up the document root directory.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns the root directory entry for the document provider, including support flags and metadata.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves an EncryptedDocument instance for the given document ID.

methods.name: includeDocument
methods.description: Populates a cursor with metadata for a document, including size, MIME type, and flags.

methods.name: isChildDocument
methods.description: Checks recursively if a document is a descendant of a parent directory.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document or directory, assigns an ID, and updates parent directory metadata.

methods.name: initDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document with initial metadata, without content.

methods.name: renameDocument
methods.description: Updates the display name of an existing document.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document and its children, and cleans up references.

methods.name: deleteDocumentTree
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and all its children.

methods.name: deleteDocumentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a document from parent directories.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Returns metadata for a specific document as a cursor.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Returns a cursor over the children of a directory document.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a document for reading or writing, returning a file descriptor.

methods.name: startRead
methods.description: Starts a background thread to read and decrypt document content, providing a reliable pipe.

methods.name: startWrite
methods.description: Starts a background thread to encrypt and write document content through a pipe.
